device_enrollment.title: Device Enrollment
device_enrollment.search: Search serial, UUID, or hardware ID
device_enrollment.connection_limited_help: The device is still connected to MQTT, but its enrollment state or missing host record prevents normal business data ingestion. Online does not mean the device is operational.
device_enrollment.disabled: Automated enrollment is disabled. Complete the migration, model identities, and assembly slots before enabling it.
device_enrollment.risk_actions_help: Platform administrators only. Quarantine can be released. Revocation permanently invalidates the current MQTT credential, but access can be restored by issuing a new credential after identity verification.
device_enrollment.quarantine_warning: After quarantine, reports are not accepted for ingestion even if the device remains connected to MQTT. Its credential is retained, and Release can restore processing.
device_enrollment.release_warning: After release, device reports are accepted again and topology matching restarts.
device_enrollment.revoke_warning: Revocation immediately disables the current MQTT credential, which cannot be restored. Business assets and history are retained. If the production manifest remains active, the device can prove its private key again and receive a new credential. A revoked manifest or replaced device key requires its corresponding recovery flow first.
device_enrollment.revoked_help: The current credential is revoked and cannot be restored, but device assets and history remain. Reverify the device identity or use the authorized recovery flow appropriate to the revocation reason.
device_enrollment.revoked_factory_help: Both the production-manifest identity and MQTT credential are revoked. Reactivate the production record, then have the device complete private-key proof again.
device_enrollment.revoked_manual_help: An administrator revoked the current MQTT credential. If the production manifest is still active, the device can complete private-key proof again to obtain a new credential.
device_enrollment.revoked_rekey_help: The repair rekey is confirmed and the current credential remains revoked. Have the device prove the new private key so the system can issue a new credential.
device_enrollment.confirm_replacement_warning: This atomically moves the existing Pod and all nodes from the offline source Host to this Host while preserving asset and topology history. Confirm that the source Host is powered off.
device_enrollment.confirm_replacement_success: Host replacement and node transfer completed
